preconditions.description: The number of games T must be between 1 and 100.
Each query Q must be between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.description: The answer ans must satisfy either an absolute error of at most 7 or a relative error of at most 0.5 compared to the actual number of divisors d.
The number of queries made must not exceed 22.
